title: Senior AI Engineer — Founding Team
skills_required: Production experience with embeddings-based retrieval systems (e.g., sentence-transformers, OpenAI embeddings, BGE, E5)
Experience handling embedding drift, index refresh, retrieval-quality regression in production
Production experience with vector databases or hybrid search infrastructure (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, FAISS)
Strong Python skills with a focus on code quality
Hands-on experience designing evaluation frameworks for ranking systems (NDCG, MRR, MAP, offline-to-online correlation, A/B test interpretation)
skills_preferred: Experience with learning-to-rank models (XGBoost-based or neural)
Background in distributed systems or large-scale inference optimization
Open-source contributions in the AI/ML space
experience_required: 5–9 years of experience, with a strong emphasis on applied ML/AI roles at product companies. Candidates must have shipped at least one end-to-end ranking, search, or recommendation system to real users at meaningful scale. Pure research or recent LangChain-only experience without prior production ML is a disqualifier. Must be actively writing production code.
responsibilities: Own the intelligence layer of Redrob's product, including ranking, retrieval, and matching systems.
Audit existing systems (BM25 + rule-based scoring) and identify high-leverage improvements.
Ship a v2 ranking system using embeddings, hybrid retrieval, and LLM-based re-ranking to demonstrably improve recruiter-engagement metrics.
Set up comprehensive evaluation infrastructure, including offline benchmarks, online A/B testing, and recruiter-feedback loops.
Drive the long-term architecture for candidate-JD matching at scale.
Mentor new hires as the team grows.
Collaborate closely with the recruiter-experience Product Manager on product development.
technologies: Embeddings-based retrieval systems (sentence-transformers, OpenAI embeddings, BGE, E5)

leadership_expectations: Drive the long-term architecture of core product intelligence systems.
Formulate and defend strong opinions on retrieval, evaluation, and LLM integration based on practical experience.
product_mindset: Possess a scrappy product-engineering attitude, prioritizing shipping functional solutions quickly to learn from real users.
Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving requirements in a Series A startup environment.
Ability to think about product, recruiter workflows, and evaluation frameworks beyond just coding.
Bias towards shipping and iterating over pure research.
must_have_skills: Deep technical depth in modern ML systems (embeddings, retrieval, ranking, LLMs, fine-tuning).
Production experience with embeddings-based retrieval systems deployed to real users.
Experience handling embedding drift, index refresh, and retrieval-quality regression in production.
Production experience with vector databases or hybrid search infrastructure with operational expertise.
